page.layout: One column of running text, with one marginal note on the right, beside the lines "Ad hæc fora duo" to "XVII platearum". Below the text: catchword "ad" at the right.

main_text.p: ens ab area Martiniâna, & c. LXXIX passuum spatio inde in occidentem hybernum procurrens, latitudine paulò minore; intra cujus ambitum curia modica, cum œnopolio curiâ haud paulò majore cum turriculâ in vertice, contiguis parietibus: à quo trames perbrevis in alterum superiore etiam longius, Piscarium, quòd piscium illic mercatus sit, nuncupatum; in cujus fine area ac templum, quod dixi, parochiale tertium ab amne Ahâ nomen ferens. Id in longitudinem patet, si templi aream comprehenderis pass. CC. XLI, si non comprehenderis pass. c. XLIII. Ad hæc fora Viæ aut plateæ urbis, & portæ duo, quod mirêris, capita non minùs XVII platearum, & ferè amplissimarum in tota urbe pertinent: è quibus præcipuæ VI à totidem urbis portis [portæ autem sunt in universum VIII ) recta linea veniunt, Polana, Orientalis, Dominica, Pontana, Botterana, Ebbingana; eædem tota ferè urbe longissimæ, excepta Polana, quæ paulò est brevior: omnes suis portis cognomines, præter Pontanam, quæ à ponte Ahæ impositò ad

page.notes: The marginal note is set in italic type and is read as "Viæ aut plateæ urbis, & portæ"; the second word of the note is partly worn and may be "platæ". Some letters in the text are faint, especially at the line ends of lines 15–17 and near the word "templum" (line 11) and "parochiale". The catchword "ad" is partly cut off at the edge of the scan.
